description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various models on the November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing different models with diagonally rotated labels, while the vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Average score (temperature = 0.5)". The vertical axis uses a linear scale with a visible range from 60 to 90 and tick marks at regular intervals of 10. A legend indicates that light blue bars represent a "Large model" and solid blue bars represent a "Small model". The nine vertical bars are sorted in ascending order of their scores, and each is annotated with its exact numerical value and an error bar at the top. The shortest bar, representing a large model with a score of 66.4, has its label partially obscured by a gray rectangle, leaving only "70b-Instruct" visible. The subsequent bars represent Claude 3.5 Sonnet (light blue, 74.8), Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct (blue, 77.4), GPT 4o (light blue, 77.9), GPT 4o-mini (blue, 78.2), Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct (light blue, 78.7), Gemini Flash 1.5 (blue, 81.6), and Gemini Pro 1.5 (light blue, 89.8). The tallest bar represents phi-4, a small model with a score of 91.8, and its corresponding horizontal axis label is visually emphasized in bold text.
